_about: ONE case table, TWO readers. Each row is process output as the Next bridge receives it; `expect` is what the bridge reads out of it. app/_lib/python-runner-bridge-cases.test.ts runs every row through the REAL parsePythonJson / parseStderrError, pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_bridge_reader.py runs it through the Python port in _helpers.py (read_stdout_payload / read_stderr_envelope) that every CLI test reads its output with. A reader changed on one side only turns one of the two suites red. stdout rows: expect {payload} or {error: true} (the bridge throws). stderr rows: expect {envelope: {message, status, code}}; exit null is a process killed by a signal.

stdout.name: trailing interpreter chatter after the result
a warning printed before the result
CRLF line endings and trailing blank lines
the LAST object wins over an earlier one
a bare scalar after the result is skipped
a top-level array is a payload
an empty object is still a payload
a bare number alone is not a payload
a bare string alone is not a payload
null alone is not a payload
empty stdout is an error, never an empty object
NaN is not JSON to the bridge
pretty-printed JSON spans lines and is not read

stderr.name: coded envelope after a warning line
status 404 with no code derives not_found
status 504 with no code derives timeout
a blank emitted code falls back to the status
a non-string code falls back to the status
an emitted code wins over the status
an emitted code is trimmed
no status on exit 2 reads as 400
no status on exit 1 reads as 500
a boolean status is not a status
a non-string error is the generic message
an empty object envelope is still an envelope
an array last line is an envelope with no fields
plain-text stderr on exit 2 is invalid_input
stderr.stderr:
usage: x_cli [-h]
x_cli: error: the following arguments are required: --input-json

envelope.message:
usage: x_cli [-h]
x_cli: error: the following arguments are required: --input-json

stderr.name: plain-text stderr on exit 1 is engine_error with the whole text
stderr.stderr:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "x.py", line 1
ValueError: boom

envelope.message:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "x.py", line 1
ValueError: boom

stderr.name: a scalar last line is plain text
an envelope followed by plain text is plain text
CRLF stderr reads its last line
empty stderr names the exit code
a signal kill has no exit code
